items.title: 14.13 Data ka tajziya aur hawa ke mayar ki tashreeh (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.13, printed page 317.

blocks.text: Jama shuda data ka tajziya hypothesis ki tasdeeq ya tardeed ke liye kiya jata hai, aur nataij ki tashreeh aur nateeja akhz kiya jata hai. Hawa ke mayar ke data ka tajziya aur tashreeh pollutants ki concentrations samajhne, waqt ke saath rujhanat pehchanne, aur awami sehat aur maholiyati policy ke liye un ke mazmirat jaanchne par mushtamil hai. Tajurbe mohtaat design kar ke aur data jama aur tajziya kar ke hawa ke mayar ki hypothesis parkhi ja sakti hai aur hawa ka mayar behtar karne ki hikmat-e-amliyan banai ja sakti hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek shehr ki PM2.5 readings ek hi din subah 8 baje 180 aur dopahar 2 baje 60 hain. In numbers ki tashreeh karein.
blocks.explanation: Subah 180 sab ke liye ghair-sehatmand hai, 60 darmiyana. Subah ke peak ke baad tez girawat rush-hour traffic aur raat ke inversion ki taraf ishara karti hai jis ne zarraat ko tab tak roka jab tak sooraj ne hawa garam aur mila na di; policy ka mazmir subah ke traffic ke ikhraj ghatana aur hassas groups ko subah sawere bahar ki sargarmi se bachne ki hidayat dena hai.

items: Waqt ke saath concentrations aur rujhanat ka tajziya karein, sehat aur policy ke liye tashreeh karein, nateeja nikalein ke hypothesis theek hai ya nahi, aur behtari ki mansooba-bandi ke liye nateeja istemal karein.
